Channel.Name: Status_Byte_0
Channel.Description: This channel combines various 1-bit status signals into a single byte.

Channel.Name: Status_GNSS_Mode
Channel.Description: Indicates GNSS status: 8=DGNSS precise (RTK), 4=DGNSS coarse, 2=single GNSS, 1=no GNSS

Channel.Name: Status_Standstill
Channel.Description: Indicates if the vehicle is stationary. '1' means the vehicle is at a stop, indicating no movement detected.

Channel.Name: Status_Skidding
Channel.Description: Indicates skidding. '1' means the vehicle is skidding.

Channel.Name: Status_External_Vel_Out
Channel.Description: Indicates when external velocity differs from system-measured velocity. '1' indicates a discrepancy, crucial for accuracy checks.

Channel.Name: Status_Byte_1
Channel.Description: This channel combines various 1-bit status signals into a single byte.

Channel.Name: Status_Trig_GNSS
Channel.Description: Indicates if GNSS receiver was actively sampling data. '1' means data sampling was occurring.

Channel.Name: Status_Signal_IN3
Channel.Description: Indicates if a signal was detected. '1' indicates the occurence of a Trigger signal.

Channel.Name: Status_Signal_IN2
Channel.Description: Indicates if a signal was detected. '1' indicates the occurence of a Trigger signal.

Channel.Name: Status_Signal_IN1
Channel.Description: Indicates if a signal was detected. '1' indicates the occurence of a Trigger signal.

Channel.Name: Status_Alignment
Channel.Description: Indicates that the prealignment is running. The prealignment is executed at the beginning of an ADMA measurement mode.

Channel.Name: Status_AHRS_INS
Channel.Description: 0=IMU-Mode, 1=AHRS-Mode

Channel.Name: Status_Dead_reckoning
Channel.Description: Indicates if dead reckoning is active. Dead reckoning means estimating the vehicle's position based on previously known positions when GNSS is unavailable.

Channel.Name: Status_SyncLock
Channel.Description: Indicates if ADMA-Time is adjusted. '1' indicates that GNSS and INS Time has been synchronized.

Channel.Name: Status_Byte_2
Channel.Description: This channel combines various 1-bit status signals into a single byte.

Channel.Name: Status_EVK_activ
Channel.Description: Indicates if the external-velocity Kalman filter is active and meets control criteria. '1' means active and compliant.

Channel.Name: Status_EVK_Estimates
Channel.Description: Indicates if the external-velocity Kalman filter has reliable estimates. '1' for valid estimations.

Channel.Name: Status_Heading_executed
Channel.Description: Indicates if auto init and heading setup are complete. '1' confirms execution.This happens at the first straight ahead drive after ADMA measurement start.

Channel.Name: Status_Config_Changed
Channel.Description: Indicates if the ADMA configuration changed within the current ADMA measurement. '1' means configuration was altered.

Channel.Name: Status_Tilt
Channel.Description: Displays tilt quality status: 0 (red) for poor, 1 (yellow) for moderate, 2 (green) for good. The tresholds can be configured at menu 6 - Parameters.

Channel.Name: Status_Pos
Channel.Description: Displays position quality status: 0 (red) for poor, 1 (yellow) for moderate, 2 (green) for good. The tresholds can be configured at menu 6 - Parameters.

Channel.Name: Status_Byte_3
Channel.Description: Alignment Time countdown at measurement start. Data record count 0-255 continuously at measurement.

Channel.Name: Status_Count
Channel.Description: Counts down prealignment time at measurement start. After that it gets incremented with every data sample. (0-255)

Channel.Name: Status_Byte_4
Channel.Description: This channel combines various 1-bit status signals into a single byte.

Channel.Name: Status_Kalmanfilter_settled
Channel.Description: Indicates if the Kalman filter is fully settled in all axes. '1' confirms complete initialization.

Channel.Name: Status_KF_Lat_stimulated
Channel.Description: Indicates if the Kalman filter is settled in the lateral axis. '1' confirms complete init. Lateral accelerations stimulate the initialization.

Channel.Name: Status_KF_Long_stimulated
Channel.Description: Indicates if the Kalman filter is settled in the longitudinal axis. '1' confirms complete init. Longitudinal accelerations stimulate the initialization.

Channel.Name: Status_KF_steady_state
Channel.Description: Indicates if Kalman filter bias estimates are found. '1' means biases are settled and reliable. Constant velocities and standstill stimulate the init.

Channel.Name: Status_Speed
Channel.Description: Displays speed quality status: 0 (red) for poor, 1 (yellow) for moderate, 2 (green) for good. The tresholds can be configured at menu 6 - Parameters.

Channel.Name: Status_IPS_mode
Channel.Description: 0=GNSS Mode, 1=IPS Mode - Indicates if IPS mode oder GNSS mode is active

Channel.Name: Status_Byte_5
Channel.Description: This channel combines various 1-bit status signals into a single byte.

Channel.Name: Status_Robot
Channel.Description: 9 = RTK Mode, 8 = DGNSS Mode, 7 = GNSS Mode, 2 = Locking: GNSS ok but no Init and no TimeSynclock; 3 = GNSS Outage, 0 = Error

Channel.Name: Status_DualAnt_Mode
Channel.Description: Indicates DualAnt status: 0=error 1=no solution, 2=differential solution without carrier phase, 4=Multi-frequency RTK solution with unresolved float carrier phase ambiguities, 8=Multi-frequency RTK solution with resolved carrier phase ambiguities

Channel.Name: Status_Byte_6
Channel.Description: This channel combines various 1-bit status signals into a single byte.

Channel.Name: Status_Byte_7
Channel.Description: This channel combines various 1-bit status signals into a single byte.

Channel.Name: Error_Byte_0
Channel.Description: This channel combines various 1-bit error signals into a single byte.

Channel.Name: Error_Hardware
Channel.Description: Indicates hardware error due to low voltage in Gyro, Accelerometer, External Velocity or GNSS Receiver.

Channel.Name: Error_Gyro_HW
Channel.Description: Indicates a hardware error in the gyroscope. Indicates issues due to malfunction or faults in this sensor.

Channel.Name: Error_Accel_HW
Channel.Description: Indicates a hardware error in the accelerometer. Indicates issues due to malfunction or faults in this sensor.

Channel.Name: Error_Ext_Speed_HW
Channel.Description: Indicates hardware error in external velocity signal due to missing pulses from the sensor, indicating a sensor malfunction.

Channel.Name: Error_GNSS_HW
Channel.Description: Indicates a hardware malfunction in the GNSS Receiver, pointing to issues or faults within the GNSS system.

Channel.Name: Error_Misc1
Channel.Description: Flags various hardware errors. For detailed definitions, refer to the Technical Documentation.

Channel.Name: Error_Data_Bus_Checksum
Channel.Description: Indicates a critical error in the data bus, suggesting significant communication or transmission issues.

Channel.Name: Error_EEProm
Channel.Description: Indicates an error in the EEPROM, specifically related to missing or inaccessible calibration data.

Channel.Name: Error_CMD
Channel.Description: Indicates an error in processing commands, signifying issues with command interpretation or execution.

Channel.Name: Error_Byte_1
Channel.Description: This channel combines various 1-bit error signals into a single byte.

Channel.Name: Error_Misc2
Channel.Description: Flags various errors. For detailed definitions, refer to the Technical Documentation.

Channel.Name: Error_Data_Bus
Channel.Description: Indicates a critical error in the data bus, suggesting significant communication or transmission issues.

Channel.Name: Error_CAN_Bus
Channel.Description: Indicates an error encountered in CAN operations, pointing to communication issues.

Channel.Name: Error_Num
Channel.Description: Signals an error in numerical computations or processing, indicating calculation issues within the system.

Channel.Name: Error_Misc3
Channel.Description: Flags various errors. For detailed definitions, refer to the Technical Documentation.

Channel.Name: Error_Temp_Warning
Channel.Description: Indicates a temperature-related warning, suggesting the system is operating outside of its optimal temperature range.

Channel.Name: Error_Reduced_Accuracy
Channel.Description: Flags a decrease in sensor accuracy, indicating that sensor readings may not be as precise as expected.

Channel.Name: Error_Range_Max
Channel.Description: Indicates that the measuring range has been exceeded, possibly causing unreliable data due to Kalman filter disorientation

Channel.Name: Error_Byte_2
Channel.Description: This channel combines various 1-bit error signals into a single byte.

Channel.Name: Warn_GNSS
Channel.Description: This channel combines various 1-bit warning signals into a single byte.

Channel.Name: Warn_GNSS_no_solution
Channel.Description: Indicates a failure in position determination.The GNSS-Receiver is unable to calculate position.

Channel.Name: Warn_GNSS_Vel_ignored
Channel.Description: Indicates that GNSS velocity data appears inaccurate and is therefore disregarded.

Channel.Name: Warn_GNSS_Pos_ignored
Channel.Description: GNSS Position seems not correct - Data ignored

Channel.Name: Warn_GNSS_unable_to_cfg
Channel.Description: GNSS unable to configure, still booting

Channel.Name: Warn_Misc1
Channel.Description: Flags various warnings. For detailed definitions, refer to the Technical Documentation.

Channel.Name: Warn_speed_off
Channel.Description: Indicates that the external velocity signal is invalid, suggesting issues with external velocity data accuracy.

Channel.Name: Warn_GNSS_DualAnt_ignored
Channel.Description: Indicates GNSS position data is suspected to be inaccurate and thus is not used.

Channel.Name: Warn_Mounting_offsets
Channel.Description: Invalid configured mounting offsets. Please verify that the mounting offsets have been configured correctly.

Channel.Name: Error_Byte_3
Channel.Description: This channel combines various 1-bit error signals into a single byte.

Channel.Name: Error_HW_Sticky
Channel.Description: Counts and reports the number of hardware errors detected, tracking system malfunctions over time.
